[SWS_DM_00098] UDS message checks
⌈
The Diagnostic Server
instance shall check, whether the diagnostic request is syntactically correct. I.e.
whether it conforms to ISO 14229-1 message format specification. If it does not con-
form, the Verification shall be considered as failed and the negative response code
shall be 0x13 (incorrectMessageLengthOrInvalidFormat)
⌋
